problem.text: Your AI assistant can answer questions. But ask it to take a screenshot, track a file, or send a message — and it's helpless.

solution.text: AgiMate gives AI eyes, ears, and hands. Install the app on a device — and your AI agent can see, hear, and act.

items.title: AI Secretary
items.description: Monitoring incoming messages in Email, Telegram, WhatsApp. AI analyzes, categorizes, and responds to common questions.

items.title: Document Automation
items.description: Tracking new files, recognizing document types, extracting data, and uploading to 1C or CRM.

items.title: Monitoring & Alerts
items.description: Tracking device events — screenshots, notifications, changes. AI analyzes and sends alerts.

items.title: E-commerce Assistant
items.description: Monitoring orders on Ozon and Wildberries, automatic status updates, customer responses.

items.title: Competitor Price Monitoring
items.description: Tracking competitor product prices on marketplaces. AI analyzes changes and suggests adjustments.

items.title: Legacy Software Bridge
items.description: AI controls desktop apps without APIs — 1C, Excel, specialized software. Integration with modern services.

items.title: Voice Notifications
items.description: Important events are voiced via TTS on the device. Don't miss critical alerts, even if you're not looking at the screen.

items.title: Data Collection & Reports
items.description: Automatic data collection from various sources, aggregation, and scheduled report generation.
